sources.title: OpenVoiceOS/qwen3-asr-0.6b-arabic-dialectal-v2-onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Dialect coverage Trained on oddadmix/lahgtna-v3-small (dialect-balanced, undiacritized targets), the same corpus as the other oddadmix v2 dialectal releases. Per the family's pattern, expect strongest results on Gulf/Saudi and Egyptian, weakest on Maghrebi dialects (Tunisian, Algerian, Moroccan). This ONNX export does not change accuracy; it reproduces the source model's behavior.
